_comment: Registry of tracked oils. Only pure, single-source oils (no blends). 'standard_pack' is the unit each oil is standardised to for the 'price per unit' view. 'density_kg_per_l' converts a volume price to a mass price for the 'price per metric tonne' view. Palm is sold by weight, so its density is null and its per-kg price scales straight to per-tonne.

sunflower.label: Sunflower
sunflower.notes: Refined / high-oleic sunflower oil. Single source.

soybean.label: Soybean (pure veg)
soybean.notes: Sold in the UK as 'pure vegetable oil' that is 100% soya bean oil (e.g. KTC Pure Vegetable). Single source, NOT a rapeseed/palm blend.

palm.label: Palm
palm.notes: 100% palm frying fat block. Sold by weight.

olive_ev.label: Olive (extra virgin)
olive_ev.notes: Extra virgin olive oil. Standardised to the 5L cash & carry tin (not sold in 20L drums).
